items.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
items.summary: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.

items.title: BitMart founder says security team severely understaffed after new hack
items.summary: The crypto exchange's founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.

items.title: Crypto PACs eye 2028 new map as Democrats take Congress
items.summary: Crypto super PACs spent more than $176 million on the midterms, but the Democratic sweep raises the prospect of tougher industry scrutiny.

items.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
items.summary: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance's wallet infrastructure.

items.title: Why Bitcoin's Next Soft Fork Could Feel Like a Practice Run
items.summary: Matt Corallo explains why patching four legacy bugs is about rebuilding muscle memory, just as much as it's about Bitcoin maintenance.

items.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers' Reach
items.summary: Coinbase told customers it wasn't affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets.

items.title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
items.summary: Strive added 124 Bitcoin for about $10 million and now trails Twenty One Capital by 390 BTC for third place among Treasury companies.

items.title: Democratic sweep of Congress forces crypto industry to rethink Washington strategy
items.summary: After two years of a pro-crypto, pro-innovation climate in Washington, the digital asset industry faces a sharp political jolt.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds past $80,000 as markets shrug off midterms and Binance hack
items.summary: Bitcoin rose 3.5% to $80,500 and ether jumped 6% after Democrats won Congress, while Bitwise says the Binance hack had limited market impact.

items.title: Coinbase says 99% of customer assets sit in cold storage after Binance's $6.3 billion breach
items.summary: Coinbase says 99% of customer assets are in cold storage and it wasn't affected by the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

items.title: Circle reports $865 million in Q3 revenue and reserve income, discloses 5% workforce reduction
items.summary: Circle reported $865 million in third-quarter revenue and reserve income and disclosed cuts affecting approximately 5% of its workforce.

items.title: Polkadot lost $1.38 million after hacker exploited security flaw fixed four months earlier
items.summary: The attacker resumed on October 26 with its own relayer before the XCM fix; a later upgrade corrected supply without changing balances.

items.title: Aave and Lido lose $1.7B in massive DeFi capital drop after the Binance hack
items.summary: Stablecoin contraction was evident before the breach, while Aave's temporary freeze showed how collateralized loans can coexist with scarce withdrawal cash.

items.title: Bitcoin rockets above $80,000 for first time since Binance hack despite Democrats sweep
items.summary: Bitcoin surged more than 5% from its election-night low to reclaim $80,000 for the first time since Binance's record hack.

items.title: American Bitcoin (ABTC) Posts $126 Million Profit as Holdings Gain $197 Million
items.summary: American Bitcoin swung to about $126 million in third-quarter net income after a $197.3 million gain on its bitcoin holdings.

items.title: French Bank Credit Mutuel Arkea Confirms Cyberattack as ZachXBT Puts Losses Above $133 Million
items.summary: Credit Mutuel Arkea says a cyberattack through a service provider enabled fraudulent transfers from its own account, while ZachXBT puts the theft above $133 million.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Holds Near $80,000 as Democratic Sweep Sparks Short Squeeze
items.summary: Bitcoin price holds near $80,000 after rebounding from an election-night low of $75,600, as a short squeeze, a stock rally and a 9% drop in oil follow the Democratic sweep of Congress.

items.title: House Democrats Eye Their Own Crypto Market Structure Bill With a Bigger SEC Role After Sweep
items.summary: House Democrats are discussing a crypto market structure bill built on Rep. Maxine Waters' rejected Clarity Act amendments, with a bigger SEC role.

items.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
items.summary: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight.

items.title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
items.summary: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark.

items.title: U.S. Democratic sweep could be the final nail in the Clarity Act's coffin
items.summary: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and stocks reverse overnight plunge following Blue Wave landslide
items.summary: The biggest losers, so far, are the AI data center stocks following victories for several candidates who campaigned expressly against the sector.
